hook: Wales ended a 73-year drought by beating New Zealand 35-28.

sections.voiceover: Wales ended a 73-year drought by beating New Zealand 35-28.
b_roll: historic stadium scoreboard showing Wales 35 New Zealand 28

sections.voiceover: On November 14, 2026, Wales scored five tries at the Principality Stadium. How did Wales hold off New Zealand to secure 35 points?
b_roll: Principality Stadium packed crowd schematic diagram
match timeline diagram illustrating five tries scored

sections.voiceover: But Wales couldn't rely on tries alone, making a record tally of 346 tackles.
b_roll: defensive tactic graphic highlighting 346 tackles count

sections.voiceover: The result erased 34 consecutive defeats dating back to December 19, 1953.
b_roll: player tackle statistic chart for Dafydd Jenkins
timeline visualization from December 19 1953 to November 14 2026

sections.voiceover: Wales finally defeated New Zealand after 73 years of waiting.
b_roll: final match score display with 73 year milestone indicator
